text: AISIN CORPORATION's major shareholders (its IR 'Stock Information' page, as of June 18, 2025) are Toyota Motor Corporation with 22.34% of voting rights and The Master Trust Bank of Japan (trust account) with 10.94%; other large holders are trust accounts, Toyota group companies, insurers and an employee stock ownership association.
short: Toyota Motor is Aisin's largest holder with 22.34% of voting rights.
